name: InitObject
evidence: slot 0 of the root class 0x01: runs its slot 1 (class defaults) then slot 2 (link into the parent's list); class 0x02's set-up func_00123ED0 calls it

name: StartObject
evidence: slot 16: calls func_001837E0 with index 0, which looks up the event record 0 in the table at +0x2C and queues it with the world; class 0x02's override calls it first and then starts the children

name: AddObjectToParentList
evidence: slot 2: appends itself to its parent's children list (or the world's list at +0x48 when it has no parent) unless already linked, then runs slot 4 if the whole chain to the world is linked

name: AttachObject
evidence: slot 4: runs the hook slot 6, then slot 14 with kind 1 (class 0x02's override also attaches every child)

name: RegisterObject
evidence: slot 6: empty in the base; class 0x02's override (func_001240F8) is what puts the object into the world's lists and AttachObject calls it first

name: RemoveObjectFromParentList
evidence: slot 3: unlinks itself from its parent's children list (or the world's list at +0x48) if present, running slot 5 first when the chain to the world was linked

name: AddObjectKeyToOwner
evidence: pushes a node with its own id on the key list at +0x2CC of itself (descriptor flag 1) or of its parent

name: AddObjectKeyIfLevelInRange
evidence: runs AddObjectKeyToOwner when the target's range holds g_currentEntry's level (IsInsideRange); a script built-in of func_00109488

name: DetachObject
evidence: slot 5: runs the hook slot 7, then slot 14 with kind 2 (RemoveObjectFromParentList calls it)

name: UnregisterObject
evidence: slot 7: empty in the base; class 0x02's override (func_001243E0) takes the object out of the world's lists and DetachObject calls it first

name: ResolveAndStartObject
evidence: when the object is attached (IsObjectAttached), calls its resolve slot (15) if any, its start slot (16) and its slot 3 (a dozen loaders call it)

name: IsObjectDescendantOf
evidence: walks up the parent chain from node looking for target; returns 1 on a hit, and 1 for a null target

name: ReparentObject
evidence: slot 21: runs slot 3 (leave the old parent's list), stores the new parent at +0x18, runs slot 2 (join its list)

name: IsObjectAttached
evidence: walks up the parent chain checking each node is in its parent's children list (or the world's list at +0x48); 1 only when all are

name: GetObjectAttached
evidence: writes IsObjectAttached through its out pointer (a script built-in of func_00109488)

name: CreateObjectCopy
evidence: creates an object of the same class id with CreateTypedRecord for the given world and parent, then calls its slot 12 with the original

name: CloneObject
evidence: slot 8: only calls slot 9 with the source; class 0x02's override also clones the children

name: CopyObjectData
evidence: slot 9: copies the source's bytes after the 0x34-byte header and its two property blocks (+0x04, +0x2C), re-registers the id in the world's id lists and takes the alias

name: AddCallbackNode
evidence: takes a node from the pool func_001DBBD8, stores fn and ctx in it and pushes it on the list head (func_00183290 and func_001832F0 call it)

name: RemoveCallbackNode
evidence: walks the list for the node whose two keys match, unlinks it and returns it to the pool with func_001DBC18

name: AddObjectCallback
evidence: slot 25: adds a function and context to the callback list at +0x28 through func_001831E8

name: RemoveObjectCallback
evidence: slot 26: removes a function and context from the callback list at +0x28 through func_00183238

name: AddObjectListener
evidence: slot 23: adds to the callback list at +0x28 the listener's slot 13 with the listener as context (func_001831E8)

name: RemoveObjectListener
evidence: slot 24: removes from the callback list at +0x28 the entry of the listener's slot 13 with the listener as context (func_00183238)

name: SendObjectNotification
evidence: slot 14: calls slot 13 (kind, arg) when it is set, then calls each callback of the list at +0x28 with the same kind and arg

name: LoadObjectProperties
evidence: slot 10: calls func_0011EC40, which reads (index, value) records from the level stream until the stream ends and applies each with func_0011E680 using the table D_002505D8

name: MatchesObjectId
evidence: 0 for id -1, else 1 when the id equals the object's own id or its alias's id

name: GetAliasId
evidence: returns the alias's id, or -1 when the object has no alias

name: GetEffectiveObjectId
evidence: returns the alias's id when the object has an alias, otherwise its own id

name: GetObjectAliasId
evidence: writes GetAliasId through its out pointer (a script built-in of func_00109488)

name: RunScriptEventHandler
evidence: looks key up in the object's script scope, makes a child scope and evaluates the handler body and each argument item in it

name: SuppressScriptEvent
evidence: decides by the event index (thirty, jtbl_0024B170) whether TriggerScriptEvent should drop an event: a timer at +0x29C not yet run out, a matching argument, or the same handler already queued for the object in the world's list at +0x1EC8 (which it updates); nonzero drops it

name: TriggerScriptEvent
evidence: when the object's scope has handler idx and func_00183668 declines, queues RunScriptEventHandler for the world (func_001DBCC8) with the argument list from BuildScriptListFromPairs

name: SetExtraObjectPropertyBool
evidence: wraps a bool in a script value and passes it to SetExtraObjectProperty

name: SetExtraObjectPropertyInt
evidence: wraps an integer in a script value and passes it to SetExtraObjectProperty (func_00100720 calls it)

name: SetExtraObjectPropertyFloat
evidence: wraps a float in a script value and passes it to SetExtraObjectProperty

name: SetExtraObjectPropertyVectorB
evidence: copies a vector into a payload of the second vector kind (AcquireVectorBPayload), wraps it and passes it to SetExtraObjectProperty

name: SetExtraObjectPropertyPair
evidence: copies an 8-byte pair into a pair payload, wraps it with SetScriptValuePair and passes it to SetExtraObjectProperty

name: SetExtraObjectPropertyWord
evidence: the same body as SetExtraObjectPropertyInt: wraps an integer in a script value for SetExtraObjectProperty (func_00100A78 calls it)

name: SetExtraObjectPropertyVectorA
evidence: copies a vector into a payload of the first vector kind (AcquireVectorAPayload), wraps it and passes it to SetExtraObjectProperty

name: InitConeVolume
evidence: slot 0 of the 0x51 class: sets the mode to 0, the range to 200 and 2000, the angles to 60, copies two vectors, calls UpdateConeVolumeTangents then the base set-up func_00123ED0

name: RefreshConeVolume
evidence: slot 19 of class 0x51: base func_00125138, then func_001841D0 and func_00184B58

name: RemoveConeVolumeFromWorldList
evidence: removes itself from the world's list at +0x1BE8, then func_001841B0

name: AddConeVolumeToWorldList
evidence: adds itself to the world's list at +0x1BE8 and calls slot 18 when it has one

name: RegisterConeVolume
evidence: slot 6 of class 0x51: base register func_001240F8, then AddConeVolumeToWorldList

name: UnregisterConeVolume
evidence: slot 7 of class 0x51: base unregister func_001243E0, then RemoveConeVolumeFromWorldList

name: CopyConeVolume
evidence: slot 9 of the 0x51 class: calls the parent copy func_00127048 while keeping the saved pair at 0x410, with a re-register around it when value differs

name: FitLineThroughPoints
evidence: returns the intercept and slope of the line through (a,b) and (c,d); a vertical pair gives slope 0 and intercept b

name: FitReciprocalThroughPoints
evidence: solves out + t/x through (x,y) and (z,w): t = x*z*(w-y)/(x-z), out = y - t/x, with a zero fallback

name: FitUnitRampBetweenPair
evidence: calls FitLineThroughPoints for the line that is 1 at the pair's x and 0 at its y

name: FitLineThroughAngleSamples
evidence: turns two angles (halved, to radians, t + t^3) and two bytes (scaled by 1/255) into two points and calls FitLineThroughPoints

name: NoteConeVolumeLightingChange
evidence: when the cone volume's value at +0x304 is 0, stamps g_lightingChangeFrame with the frame count D_002622CC; RefreshConeVolumeShape and RemoveConeVolumeFromWorldList call it

name: RefreshConeVolumeShape
evidence: original assembly: recomputes a cone volume after any of its settings changes (SetConeVolumeMode, SetConeVolumeRange and every setter after them call it)

name: SetConeVolumeMode
evidence: stores its flag in the mode field at 0x2D0, sets or clears two flag bits by whether it is 0, then calls the refresh functions func_001841D0 and func_00184B58

name: SetConeVolumeColor
evidence: copies a hue, saturation, value quad into +0x2E0 (RefreshConeVolumeShape turns it to red, green, blue with func_001B4580) and refreshes the shape; CreateConeVolumes and CreateArcSprite call it

name: SetConeVolumeSecondLevel
evidence: stores the level at +0x2F0, which RefreshConeVolumeShape pairs with the angle at +0x2FC (FitLineThroughAngleSamples), and refreshes the shape

name: SetConeVolumeThirdLevel
evidence: stores the level at +0x2F4, which RefreshConeVolumeShape pairs with 360 less the angle at +0x300 (FitLineThroughAngleSamples), and refreshes the shape

name: SetConeVolumeFirstAngle
evidence: stores the angle at +0x2F8 (180 at set-up), which RefreshConeVolumeShape pairs with the color's value at +0x2E8, and refreshes the shape

name: SetConeVolumeSecondAngle
evidence: stores the angle at +0x2FC (240 at set-up), which RefreshConeVolumeShape pairs with the level at +0x2F0, and refreshes the shape

name: SetConeVolumeThirdAngle
evidence: stores the angle at +0x300 (180 at set-up), which RefreshConeVolumeShape pairs with the level at +0x2F4, and refreshes the shape

name: SetConeVolumeDirection
evidence: stores a vector at +0x310 and its negated unit vector at +0x320 (the unit z vector when it is shorter than 1e-4), then refreshes the shape and the bounds (UpdateConeVolumeBounds)

name: SetConeVolumeValue
evidence: when the value at 0x304 changes stores it and runs func_001841D0

name: SetConeVolumeRange
evidence: copies one eight-byte pair into the adjacent rangeMin and rangeMax fields (default 200 and 2000) then calls the refresh functions

name: SetConeVolumeOuterAngle
evidence: stores its float in outerAngle (60 at set-up), then calls UpdateConeVolumeTangents and the refresh functions

name: SetConeVolumeInnerAngle
evidence: stores its float in innerAngle, then calls UpdateConeVolumeTangents and func_001841D0

name: SetConeVolumeVector340
evidence: copies a quad into +0x340 (D_00248D10 at set-up) and refreshes the shape and the bounds (UpdateConeVolumeBounds); a script built-in of func_00109488

name: UpdateConeVolumeTangents
evidence: clamps outerAngle to 0..175 and innerAngle to 0..outerAngle, and stores func_002054F0 of each angle times pi/360 and their ratios in the 0x350..0x36C fields

name: UpdateConeVolumeBounds
evidence: when the value at +0x304 is set, computes the bounding sphere at +0x3D0 by mode: unbounded (0xFFFFFFF) in mode 0, rangeMax around the position in mode 1, around the cone's reach from outerAngle and rangeMax in modes 2 and 3 (func_001EEB60)

name: SetConeVolumeOuterLevels
evidence: stores one level in both +0x2F0 and +0x2F4 (SetConeVolumeSecondLevel, SetConeVolumeThirdLevel)

name: GetConeVolumeSecondLevel
evidence: writes the level at +0x2F0 through its out pointer (a script built-in of func_00109488)

name: SetConeVolumeColorRgb
evidence: converts a red, green, blue quad to hue, saturation, value with func_001B4600 and sets it with SetConeVolumeColor

name: GetConeVolumeColorRgb
evidence: converts the hue, saturation, value quad at +0x2E0 to red, green, blue with func_001B4580 into the caller's buffer
